Welcome. Have you ever noticed how your inner voice shapes the way you see yourself, and even the choices you make each day? That running commentary in your mind—it can be your biggest supporter, or sometimes, your toughest critic.
Together, we’re about to explore how these internal conversations truly create the landscape of your daily experience. Imagine what might change if you could turn that self-talk into a powerful force for growth. That’s exactly what we’ll uncover in Shad Helmstetter’s transformative book, What to Say When You Talk to Yourself.
Helmstetter dives deep into the hidden scripts playing in our minds—those subtle patterns that quietly steer our emotions, actions, and even our sense of possibility. Whether you’re looking to break old habits, build confidence, or simply understand yourself a bit better, we’ll discover practical ways to recognize—and rewrite—the words we say to ourselves.
So, get ready to find out how changing your self-talk can open the door to resilience, motivation, and lasting success. Together, let’s see how a few new words can lead to a whole new way of living. Let’s get started on this journey.
